extracted.name: Sweet and Tangy BBQ Sauce
extracted.description: This sweet and tangy BBQ sauce recipe gets its sweetness from apple juice, honey, brown sugar, and molasses, and its tang from vinegar, ketchup, and spices.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add onion; cook and stir until tender. Stir in ketchup, cider vinegar, water, apple juice, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, molasses, honey, mustard powder, chili powder, garlic powder, and cayenne pepper; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
